---
title: "SwissModel"
description: "Submit a protein sequence for structure modeling and inspect model quality, PDB information and 3D output."
---

## Inputs

The current SwissModel module accepts:

- a **protein sequence**;
- a **Swiss-Model API token**.

An example sequence can be inserted from the interface to verify the workflow.

## Workflow

1. Paste the protein sequence.
2. Enter a valid API token.
3. Click **Run**.
4. Open the generated project link when available.
5. Review **Project Information** and the **Model Quality** table.
6. Inspect **PDB Information**, the **Ramachandran Plot**, **Residue Composition**, and the interactive **3D Structure**.
7. Download the project information, PDB file and model-quality results.

## Interpretation

Model quality should be assessed before structural conclusions are drawn. Pay particular attention to template support, global/local quality estimates, unresolved/disordered regions and stereochemical diagnostics.

::: {.callout-warning}
Do not publish or share API tokens in screenshots, notebooks, repositories or exported project files. Treat the token as a credential.
:::
